# Immediate predecessor fixture

These original AGPL source files are frozen from the installed
`0.3.0-dev.9` CI candidate, commit
`7e408f0b292b3c63c20775dc2337b8d42f0fadce`.
They are test inputs, never included in release bundles. They exercise the
actual predecessor writer (five-field stock, eight-field active) and its own
renderer/sealer during newer-media maintenance and interrupted upgrades.
Physical adapters are replaced only in each temporary test package.
Older active snapshot formats are outside the current compatibility scope.
